capability_definition: Acquire, reconcile, maintain, explain and present trustworthy education information with provenance and controlled correction.
user_problem: Education information is fragmented, inconsistent, stale or hard to trust.
ownership: StudyNexus owns its accepted canonical representation and information-quality process; external authorities own underlying authoritative facts.
external_dependencies: Authoritative/public sources; user reports; external data providers where appropriate.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not permit scraper/AI/user input to mutate canonical facts silently.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/04-open-questions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/canonical/06-data-acquisition.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md | Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Category-specific source authority; public trust-signal UX.

capability_definition: Help users find and explore educational institutions using meaningful criteria and geography.
user_problem: Users cannot efficiently discover suitable institutions across fragmented sources.
ownership: StudyNexus owns discovery experience and accepted institution representation; institutions/regulators remain authoritative for external facts.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not enroll users or act as the institution.
open_questions: Facet/relevance refinements are product tuning, not scope blockers.

capability_definition: Present structured, trustworthy institution identity, location, status and other decision-relevant information.
user_problem: Users must reconcile scattered institution facts manually.
ownership: StudyNexus owns its canonical representation; authoritative institution/regulator facts remain externally owned.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not make external regulatory decisions.
open_questions: Exact minimum fact set may evolve.

capability_definition: Represent and expose what an institution actually offers using source-faithful terminology and relevant real-world context.
user_problem: Programme/course information differs among institutions and must not be flattened into misleading global labels.
ownership: StudyNexus maintains accepted representation of sourced offering facts; institution remains authoritative for its offering.
external_dependencies: Institution sources; regulatory/accreditation sources where relevant.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not require discovery classification to exist; does not equal Discovery Programme.
open_questions: Precise offering-context vocabulary for campus/delivery/cycle variations.
assumptions: Institution Offering is preferred product term; ProgrammeInstance remains historical technical abstraction.

capability_definition: Create and maintain StudyNexus-curated discovery concepts/classifications that help users find comparable or related institution offerings without rewriting source-faithful terminology.
user_problem: Source-faithful offering names are heterogeneous and can impede cross-institution discovery.
ownership: StudyNexus owns curated discovery concepts/classification; institutions own source-faithful offering facts.
external_dependencies: Institution Offering information; possibly subject/qualification taxonomies.
exclusions_boundaries: Classification may be optional; unclassified offerings remain valid.
open_questions: Classification cardinality and vocabulary schemes.
assumptions: Discovery Programme remains a separate curated product concept.

capability_definition: Explain institution/offering admission information such as requirements, cut-offs, Post-UTME and applicable admission context.
user_problem: Applicants face fragmented, contextual and changing admission information.
ownership: StudyNexus owns its accepted representation/explanation; institutions/JAMB/other authorities own authoritative rules.
external_dependencies: Institution, JAMB and other authoritative admission sources.
exclusions_boundaries: Information/decision support only; StudyNexus does not execute admission.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/V4.2-REMEDIATION-REPORT.md | Catchments-ELDS-Additions-03-09-2026.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Fact-specific authority/precedence remains to be refined.

capability_definition: Let users understand published requirements and compare their declared circumstances against them without claiming a final admissions decision.
user_problem: Users need to know whether they appear to meet requirements before acting.
ownership: StudyNexus owns explanation/self-assessment behavior; authorities own requirements and final eligibility/admission decisions.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not imply fully automated authoritative eligibility evaluation.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/04-open-questions.md | Catchments-ELDS-Additions-03-09-2026.md | News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Exact self-assessment UX and confidence wording.

capability_definition: Support side-by-side or contextual comparison of relevant education choices using comparable facts.
user_problem: Users otherwise manually reconcile inconsistent information across sources.
ownership: StudyNexus owns comparison experience and derived presentation; source owners retain underlying fact authority.
exclusions_boundaries: A dedicated Compare page is not required to prove the capability exists.
open_questions: Minimum comparison dimensions and UI form.

capability_definition: Enable intentional retrieval of known or constrained education information using text and structured criteria.
user_problem: Users need efficient access to specific institutions, offerings or information.
ownership: StudyNexus owns search behavior; technical search engine is implementation.
exclusions_boundaries: Search infrastructure does not define product semantics.
open_questions: Relevance tuning and exact search fields.

capability_definition: Enable users to explore alternatives, combinations, related opportunities and geographic options when they do not know the exact target.
user_problem: Known-target search alone is inadequate for education choice.
ownership: StudyNexus owns discovery semantics, curation and user experience.
exclusions_boundaries: Distinct from search execution and SEO publication.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/product-experience/PRODUCT-EXPERIENCE-DISCOVERY.md | Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Facet/taxonomy minimums.

capability_definition: Inform users about scholarships, grants, bursaries, aid and other funding opportunities, explain criteria and hand off to providers where action is external.
user_problem: Funding information is fragmented and eligibility/application conditions are hard to discover.
ownership: StudyNexus owns accepted funding information/discovery; provider owns award/application workflow.
exclusions_boundaries: Not a scholarship award/disbursement/management platform.
open_questions: Minimum matching/filter criteria.

capability_definition: Explain admission catchment and Educationally Less Developed States (ELDS) rules in the context where they actually apply.
user_problem: Applicants can misinterpret geographic admission policy as an intrinsic institution attribute.
ownership: StudyNexus owns representation/explanation; admission authorities/institutions own policy.
exclusions_boundaries: Not a generic geography label attached permanently to an institution.
open_questions: Context-specific authority details by admission cycle.

capability_definition: Publish time-sensitive education reporting/updates while keeping durable canonical facts in their proper information layer.
user_problem: Users need current changes and announcements without confusing reporting with durable truth.
ownership: StudyNexus owns editorial news content; durable external facts remain represented canonically elsewhere.
external_dependencies: Primary/official sources and other attributable reporting sources.
exclusions_boundaries: News does not become source of truth merely because it reports a change.
source_paths: News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Editorial minimum/taxonomy refinements.

capability_definition: Help users discover, understand and reach education-related services/tasks and authoritative access points.
user_problem: Users need to know what service to use, where/how to access it, and who actually performs it.
ownership: StudyNexus owns information/guidance/discovery; external provider/authority owns service execution.
external_dependencies: Service providers, government/education bodies, physical/online access points.
exclusions_boundaries: StudyNexus does not execute external transactions/services unless future evidence changes the boundary.
source_paths: Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md
open_questions: Capability minimum/service taxonomy.

capability_definition: Provide trustworthy examination information and, where defined, time-specific administration/schedule changes without operating the examination.
user_problem: Students need reliable, timely exam information scattered across authorities and notices.
ownership: StudyNexus owns accepted information representation; examination authority owns exam/schedule facts.
exclusions_boundaries: Exam registration, payment, results/certification and practice engine are separate/outside this capability.
open_questions: How much of Product→Administration→Schedule Event proposal is canonical; minimum exams/data.
assumptions: Detailed September schedule model remains proposed.

capability_definition: Provide longer-lived explanatory education content and structured resources that support decisions and understanding.
user_problem: Listings alone do not explain processes, concepts and pathways.
ownership: StudyNexus owns/curates editorial evergreen content; cited external facts retain their own authority.
exclusions_boundaries: Historical content hierarchy is evidence, not mandatory structure.
source_paths: News Post-UTME - Product Discovery Additions V2 03-09-2026.md | STUDYNEXUS-V4.6-SOURCE-CORPUS/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/24-final-platform-and-capability-architecture.md
open_questions: Minimum content types and lifecycle; role of books/shelves/chapters/pages.

capability_definition: Connect education choices to plausible career directions and next-step information without promising employment outcomes.
user_problem: Learners need to understand downstream implications of study choices.
ownership: StudyNexus product responsibility remains to be refined.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not imply job placement or deterministic career prediction.
open_questions: User problem validation, minimum information, evidence/authority model.

capability_definition: Support current undergraduates with information relevant to their ongoing educational journey and next decisions.
user_problem: Existing students have education information needs beyond initial admission.
ownership: StudyNexus owns the information journey; external institutions/providers own underlying facts/actions.
external_dependencies: Institutions, funding/career/service sources depending on sub-journey.
exclusions_boundaries: WF7 is a workflow label, not necessarily a final surface.
open_questions: Exact capability minimum and boundaries.

capability_definition: Help users understand transfer options, requirements and relevant institution/programme constraints.
user_problem: Current students considering a move need reliable transition information.
ownership: StudyNexus product responsibility to represent/explain; institutions/authorities own rules.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not execute transfer application.
open_questions: Jurisdiction semantics, minimum information and relationship to admissions/offering facts.

capability_definition: Help users discover and understand postgraduate study opportunities and entry pathways.
user_problem: Graduates/undergraduates need reliable continuation options.
ownership: StudyNexus owns discovery/information representation; institutions own offering/admission facts.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not execute postgraduate admission.
open_questions: Scope, user model and minimum information.

capability_definition: Help users discover and understand internship/practical-experience opportunities relevant to education/career journeys.
user_problem: Students need practical-experience pathways and opportunity information.
ownership: StudyNexus role remains information/discovery unless stronger evidence expands it.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not imply application, placement or employer workflow execution.
open_questions: Whether to aggregate, curate or guide only; minimum data/evidence.

capability_definition: Accept user reports or contributions as evidence/candidate input to information-quality processes.
user_problem: StudyNexus needs a feedback path for missing, stale or incorrect information without letting unverified input become truth.
ownership: StudyNexus owns intake/review; contributor owns submission; canonical owner remains the accepted information layer.
exclusions_boundaries: Does not imply a full social/community network.
open_questions: Submission/identity/moderation minimums.

capability_definition: Provide persistent user identity only where it supports valuable persistent/personal capabilities while preserving anonymous core discovery/search/comparison.
user_problem: Some ongoing journeys may need saved state or identity; core discovery must not depend on it.
ownership: StudyNexus owns account experience if introduced.
exclusions_boundaries: Anonymous core remains available; account is not a prerequisite for core discovery.
open_questions: What capabilities justify account/privacy cost.
assumptions: Current canonicalization corrects earlier historical-phase bias.

capability_definition: Adapt information/guidance to user context or persistent preferences without making personalization mandatory for core use.
user_problem: Returning users may benefit from reduced repetition and more relevant guidance.
ownership: StudyNexus owns personalization behavior; source facts remain unchanged.
exclusions_boundaries: Must not obscure source/canonical truth or require identity for core discovery.
open_questions: Desired outcomes, inputs, privacy and anonymous/persistent boundaries.

capability_definition: Alert users to relevant changing information/opportunities when an appropriate delivery/consent context exists.
user_problem: Users may miss deadlines or important changes in ongoing journeys.
ownership: StudyNexus owns notification decision/experience if introduced.
external_dependencies: Communication channels; user preferences/consent; trusted source updates.
exclusions_boundaries: Must not notify from unreviewed/low-confidence changes without defined trust rules.
open_questions: Triggers, channels, consent, account dependency, trust thresholds.

capability_definition: Represent and explain externally granted regulatory/recognition statuses using the correct contextual meaning rather than a universal Recognition label.
user_problem: Users need to judge legitimacy/quality/recognition of institutions, offerings and qualifications.
ownership: StudyNexus owns accepted representation/explanation; authorities own decisions/statuses.
exclusions_boundaries: Do not invent one universal status model across jurisdictions/scopes.
open_questions: First-scope facts, authority semantics, effective dates and jurisdiction differences.

capability_definition: Product-wide jurisdiction-aware semantic principle: keep StudyNexus concepts capable of representing jurisdictional variation while public delivery remains Nigeria-first.
user_problem: Nigeria-specific assumptions can corrupt future correctness and even current cross-border information.
ownership: StudyNexus applies jurisdiction-aware semantics across relevant product capabilities.
exclusions_boundaries: Not an ordinary standalone product capability; does not imply multi-country public rollout in current delivery.
open_questions: Which current concepts require explicit jurisdiction qualifiers.

capability_definition: Potential comparative ranking/metric/intelligence capability; product membership is not yet established by substantive discovery evidence.
user_problem: Potential comparison/reputation need is hypothesized, not adequately reconstructed.
ownership: Undetermined.
exclusions_boundaries: Must not be inferred from architecture documents or empty discovery file.
open_questions: Does a validated user problem exist? Import vs normalize vs compute? What decisions would it support?

capability_definition: Direct self-service tools for institutions/providers to maintain their presence or workflows.
user_problem: Not a current product responsibility under explicit historical/current boundary evidence.
ownership: External institutions/providers remain source/actors, not current self-service users.
exclusions_boundaries: Explicitly outside current product boundary; may be reconsidered later only by a new decision.

capability_definition: Public developer access to StudyNexus data/capabilities.
user_problem: No current user/product problem establishes this as part of the product; explicitly excluded historically and not superseded.
ownership: Not current product responsibility.
exclusions_boundaries: Explicit current exclusion absent stronger superseding evidence.

capability_definition: Executing enrolment/admission applications, exam registration/payment/results/certification, scholarship award/disbursement, visa/government processing or provider transactions.
user_problem: StudyNexus is an information/discovery/handoff product rather than operator of these external transactions.
ownership: External authorities/providers own transaction execution.
external_dependencies: Institutions, exam bodies, scholarship providers, government/service systems.
exclusions_boundaries: Product may explain and hand off but does not execute these workflows.
source_paths: StudyNexus-V4.6-Developer-Handoff/PRE-IMPLEMENTATION-BASELINE-V2/archive/03-approved-decisions.md | Scholarships - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md | Education Services & Access - Product Discovery Additions 03-09-2026.md

capability_definition: Launching public StudyNexus product coverage across multiple countries.
user_problem: International expansion is strategically possible but current public delivery is Nigeria-first.
ownership: Not current delivery scope.
exclusions_boundaries: International semantics remain MVP principle; rollout itself is outside current initial delivery.

capability_definition: Deterministically evaluate a candidate profile against structured admission/funding rules and produce a machine-derived eligibility outcome.
user_problem: Could reduce manual interpretation once rules/data are sufficiently reliable.
ownership: Future StudyNexus decision-support responsibility; external authorities retain final eligibility/admission decisions.
external_dependencies: Structured authoritative rules and reliable candidate inputs.
exclusions_boundaries: Current MVP retains requirements/self-assessment instead; no authoritative admission decision.
open_questions: Rule reliability, explainability, jurisdiction variation, profile model.

capability_definition: Practice questions, learner attempts, scoring, progress and related preparation functionality.
user_problem: Could support exam preparation, but is distinct from current exam-information need.
ownership: Future product responsibility if reactivated.
external_dependencies: Exam content/question sources and learner state.
exclusions_boundaries: Distinct from examination information/schedules.
open_questions: Reactivation criteria and product evidence.

capability_definition: A persistent social/community experience with profiles, feeds, discussion or other community interaction beyond evidence/report submissions.
user_problem: Possible community value is not sufficiently discovered; user contributions alone do not establish a social product.
ownership: Undetermined.
exclusions_boundaries: Current MVP includes contribution/report input only.
open_questions: Whether a social/community problem/opportunity exists beyond information-quality contributions.
